description: Calculate the DFT+U band gap of bulk corundum Cr2O3 with antiferromagnetic ordering.
user_prompt: Calculate the band gap of bulk Cr2O3 (corundum structure, R-3c) and report its value in eV.

references: Rohrbach, Hafner & Kresse, Phys. Rev. B 70, 125426 (2004)
method.modeling: Use bulk alpha-Cr2O3 in the corundum structure with antiferromagnetic +-+- Cr-layer stacking along the hexagonal c axis.

key_parameters.dft+u: Liechtenstein U(Cr 3d)=5 eV, J(Cr 3d)=1 eV; alternative Dudarev Ueff(Cr 3d)=4 eV

method.rationale: The scored value is the 2.6 eV band-edge gap reported by Rohrbach et al. for antiferromagnetic corundum Cr2O3 using PW91-based GGA+U with U=5 eV and J=1 eV on Cr 3d. The same table reports 1.2 eV in the uncorrected GGA limit and 3.4 eV experimentally, so this benchmark is pinned to the DFT+U Ueff=4 eV convention rather than to the optical experimental gap. The absolute tolerance covers U implementation details, relaxed-geometry sensitivity, and DOS/band sampling differences.
